claim:genotype-phenotype-baseline.proposition: Classical Baselines — Random Forest and Logistic Regression on Synthetic Multi-Omic Data
claim:genotype-phenotype-baseline.hypothesis: Random Forest will outperform Logistic Regression by capturing nonlinear cross-modality interactions, but both will serve as strong baselines.

claim:quantum-classifier-evaluation.proposition: Quantum Classifier Evaluation — GenotypeToPhenotypeProcess on Synthetic Multi-Omic Data
claim:quantum-classifier-evaluation.hypothesis: The quantum classifier will achieve competitive AUC-ROC (>= 0.80) on synthetic data with strong cross-modality interactions, benefiting from the CNOT entanglement chain.

claim:v2ecoli-real-data.proposition: Real-Data Validation — Loading and Classifying v2ecoli Zarr Stores
claim:v2ecoli-real-data.hypothesis: The ZarrMultiOmicLoader will correctly handle real v2ecoli zarr structure. The quantum classifier will achieve non-trivial accuracy (>0.65 AUC-ROC).

narrative.question: Can a multi-qubit, cross-modality entangled quantum classifier outperform classical ML baselines in predicting binary phenotypes from synthetic multi-omic data?
